newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Banque Audi fell back slightly from Wednesday's record high in mixed trade and reduced turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday.
Brokers said Audi's fall to $25 was an adjustment after Wednesday's jump to $25.125.
"It is a normal fall after it rose $1.25 in one day yesterday, it is just an adjustment," a broker told Reuters.
A bloc of 55,161 Audi shares also traded on the bourse floor at $25.125.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $18.125 from $18 and Bank of Beirut rose to $3.9375 from $3.875.
"The Audi jump made investors rush to buy bank shares and this caused the other two banks to rise today," the broker said.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.16 percent to 157.91. The LISPI general index rose 0.16 percent to 89.45 and the BLOM general index rose 0.004 percent to 929.00.
Market turnover fell to 173,826 shares for a value of $2,879,103 from 230,886 shares $3,433,495.
Solidere A SOLA. BY and B shares were unchanged at $10.375 and $10.75 respectively.
Of the four industrial companies, Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.28125 on turnover of 5,000 shares while there was no trade in Ciment Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
